reviews.title: Use to love it
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for years with very minimal issues. Randomly yesterday everything I had scheduled on my calendar vanished with no trace. I can’t even restore the data from my iCloud or the app. Apparently there was an update the day this happened and I didn’t see that everything was gone until today. Very frustrating when the calendar was my life line for my ADHD brain to stay on track.

I have no idea what was on the calander for this upcoming week and now I’m going to have to download another app and remake the whole thing. Don’t get this app theres so many others to choose from !!

reviews.title: No longer has multiple alerts
reviews.text:
I am disappointed to see that the update 2.8has not fixed the issue of setting up multiple alerts for a single event.    I have the previous release (2.5.3) on my iPhone 16 pro and the app works great.   But the latest releases on my iPhone 17 pro seemed to have remove the ability to have multiple alert reminders for the event.  I normally would have the alert go off 1hr before, then 30minutes before  10 minutes before the event 

I wish Apple would let me install the previous version, because I have had no issues with it.  Both phones are on iOS 27.0.1 

It's annoying to use multiple calendars now.  

Fortunately, when I am home I have my 16 pro near me.

Wtaf??? Distressing and a horrible app with no fixes or support available. ABSOLUTELY UNRELIABLE FOR IMPORTANT THINGS WHICH  IS THE ENTIRE POINT. BEWARE DO NOT DOWNLOAD!!!

reviews.title: App Erasing everything
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for a couple months now over the summer to organize my work and my daily tasks. I really loved how you can color coordinate things on the calendar and it is pretty easy to use. 
But the reason I am giving it 2 stars is because of how many times the calendar has cleared everything I had put in. There’s no easy way to retrieve all the information lost. It was great to use the all while it was still working fine, but after clearing everything multiple times I have decided to get rid of the app.
